concerns.text: SC-006 requires that when normalized_count < 100 the system halt only the PRIMARY regression and 'proceed only to the sensitivity analysis (FR-011) if total_count >= 100'. T004's compare_thresholds exits 1 (full pipeline halt) whenever normalized < 100, with no branch that skips primary training yet runs T008's sensitivity analysis. The graceful-degradation acceptance criterion is silently dropped.

FR-014: 'If the power analysis indicates < 0.8 power ... the system MUST switch to a simpler model (Linear Regression) or report a power_insufficiency warning.' T004 only computes/writes power_analysis.json; T006 trains all three models unconditionally and never consumes the power result for model selection or emits the warning. The FR's conditional action is unimplemented.

SC-001 requires the best model's test R² to be 'measured against the baseline Linear Regression R² to quantify the improvement from non-linear modeling.' T006 reports only the single best model's metrics; no task records the Linear Regression baseline R² or the improvement delta, and model_report.schema.yaml has no field for it. The acceptance criterion does not survive into any task's verification.

concerns.location: tasks.md (all tasks) vs plan.md Constitution Check / constitution.md Principle III
concerns.text: Plan and Constitution III mandate checksumming raw data upon download with checksums recorded in state/projects/...yaml. No task (T001–T014) implements checksum computation or the state/artifact_hashes update; T002's outputs are only merged.csv and source_validation.json. A non-negotiable constitutional constraint is dropped from the task list.

concerns.location: tasks.md:T005/T006 vs constitution.md Principle VI / plan.md Constitution Check
concerns.text: Constitution VI and the plan's Constitution Check require 'interaction term construction (e.g., Power × Scanning Speed) ... strictly within the training fold' and evaluation via 5-fold CV 'rather than a single train/test split.' No task constructs interaction terms inside the Pipeline (interactions are only detected post-hoc via SHAP in T009), and T006 selects the final model on a single held-out test split. Also T005 uses standard scaling where the constitution names min-max normalization — either implement the stated mechanism or document the deviation.

T002's verification greps the codebase to prove 'no synthetic-fallback code path exists (grep for mock/synthetic)', while T004 and T010 verifications explicitly use synthetic test inputs. Narrow the grep scope to pipeline code (excluding code/tests/) or the two verification statements conflict.
